definitions.gloss: settlement of accounts, final calculation, squaring up
definitions.explanation: The act of calculating the exact amount owed and settling the balance, whether for expenses, fares, or shared costs.

examples.japanese: {経費|けいひ}を{精算|せいさん}する。
{駅|えき}の{精算|せいさん}{機|き}で{不足分|ふそくぶん}を{払|はら}った。
examples.english: I paid the shortfall at the fare adjustment machine at the station.

examples.japanese: {出張|しゅっちょう}から{戻|もど}ったら、{交通費|こうつうひ}の{精算|せいさん}を{忘|わす}れないでください。
examples.english: When you return from the business trip, please don't forget to settle your transportation expenses.

notes:
WORD FORMATION:
{精|せい} (precise, detailed) + {算|さん} (calculate) = precise calculation.

HOMOPHONE NOTE:
Do not confuse with {生産|せいさん} (production, manufacturing) or {清算|せいさん} (liquidation, settling debts/relationships). {精算|せいさん} specifically refers to precise accounting and expense settlement.

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {精算|せいさん}{機|き}: fare adjustment machine (at train stations)
- {精算|せいさん}{書|しょ}: expense report, settlement statement
- {精算|せいさん}{所|じょ}: fare adjustment window

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {経費|けいひ}を{精算|せいさん}する: to settle expenses
- {運賃|うんちん}を{精算|せいさん}する: to adjust the fare
- {立替|たてかえ}{分|ぶん}を{精算|せいさん}する: to settle the amount advanced
